verification_policy: Direct research with cross-source acquisition verification. Preserve source conflicts and do not infer Ultimate Finish requirements without explicit evidence.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 reference material identifies Neo Tri-Beam as a Ki Blast Ultimate costing 300 Ki, with additional uses consuming 100 Stamina each.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Current reference material lists Training with Tien — Lesson 4 as the acquisition route; independent instructor documentation also identifies Neo Tri-Beam as Tien's third lesson reward.
verification_audit.ultimate_finish_policy: Ultimate Finish requirement is recorded as null because this is an instructor-training acquisition and no qualifying Ultimate Finish evidence is applicable.
verification_audit.variant_policy: Neo Tri-Beam is kept distinct from Tri-Beam and DUAL Neo Tri-Beam.
verification_audit.damage_policy: Exact damage and maximum hit totals are not promoted as canonical database values because they can vary with repeated-input count, character state, and version-specific mechanics.

records.name: Neo Tri-Beam
records.skill_description: Launch a fierce Ki Blast; repeat the command to fire additional Tri-Beams while consuming Stamina.
records.mechanics_notes: Current reference classifies the attack as a long-range tracking beam Ultimate. The initial activation costs 300 Ki; each repeated input fires another Tri-Beam and consumes 100 Stamina. Current documentation lists Tien as the main user and Yamcha as a customizable partner. Kaioken's stamina-cost reduction can interact with the skill, but that interaction is retained as a mechanic rather than changing the canonical skill cost.
